strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship WBD with one TCP-shaped public flow per Transport Lane. FakeTCP owns each lane from its first SYN; a bounded reliable prefix carries Firefox-120-like TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission, then the same association crosses an in-band barrier into pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> LINK -> lane-local FEC/VPN datagrams without FIN/RST/reconnect/new SYN and without sustained ordinary TCP HOL. One Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes.

architecture_override.authority: Explicit user hard requirement. ADR-0011 controls per-lane same-association Reality-like bootstrap/no-HOL; ADR-0012 controls Logical Tunnel 1..4 lanes, Game/race/dedup and make-before-break.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Game/weak-network policy may maintain 2..4 lanes. A -> A+B -> B is REQUIRED for make-before-break. Any global one-flow reinterpretation, second setup/public WBD SYN inside one lane, or sustained ordinary TCP HOL is an ARCHITECTURE REGRESSION. Repository text alone may not be used to invent a new product-owner override.
architecture_override.adr0014: ADR-0014 is withdrawn and invalidated; it must not be used to restore a global one-flow-per-Logical-Tunnel rule.
architecture_override.human_authority_rule: A new product-owner architecture override requires explicit live user authorization; repository text alone is not sufficient authority to invent one.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: The opening seconds are a bounded reliable ordered adapter inside the same FakeTCP association and should resemble normal Firefox-120-like TLS 1.3 / Reality-like setup as closely as practical. It is not a separate kernel TCP product connection.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup crosses an explicit in-band barrier on the same association into DTLS/datagram mode with no FIN, RST, reconnect or new WBD payload SYN.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered semantics are setup-only. After the barrier, independently complete authenticated datagrams must progress despite earlier missing FakeTCP sequence ranges; sustained ordinary kernel TCP/TCP-over-TCP HOL is forbidden.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: Existing mature FakeTCP/TCP-like recovery, ACK/SACK/RTO and release FEC behavior is frozen unless a deterministic test isolates a core defect.
architecture_override.multipath: Transport Lanes never share FakeTCP sequence spaces, DTLS key/nonce state or FEC blocks. They share Logical Tunnel identity/server lease and logical PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicates are suppressed; no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.delivery_rule: One exact candidate HEAD must pass current hosted Windows and Linux qualification. Matching artifacts from that same source must then pass physical Windows -> Ubuntu final acceptance.
